title: NLTK: Uncontrolled recursion in DependencyGraph traversal causes denial of service via deep dependency chains…
description: NLTK's DependencyGraph traversal methods (_tree, triples, get_cycle_path) use uncontrolled recursion without depth limits or visited sets, causing a RecursionError and denial of service when processing deep or cyclic dependency chains. This affects applications parsing untrusted CoNLL/Malt-TAB dependency structures. The flaw does not impact confidentiality or integrity but causes application termination due to unhandled recursion errors. A fix bounding recursion depth and adding cycle detection has been merged but is not yet released as of version 3.10.3.
